title: Exercise live development SSE reconnect through CloudFront
description:
Acceptance criteria:
- exercise_thin_turn.py drops an active turn stream mid-flight and reconnects with after_seq through the named development CloudFront front door.
- Reconnect replays committed events once in order and the turn still completes.
- Record the result in a Kanbus comment on chatticus-387e4f; do not close the epic while mobile Safari and real background-tab observations remain open.
- No spike redeploy; no staging or production.
